title: Catalina as a UFO hotspot
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Catalina as a UFO hotspot, about unspecified at Santa Catalina Island, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: Santa Catalina, an island off the coast of Southern California, is said by many people to be a place where UFOs show up again and again. Jesse Michels, a podcast host, brings this up while discussing a book by Preston Dennett called Undersea UFO Base. Michels says the book covers Catalina and that many people consider the island a hotspot. A retired Navy admiral, Tim Gallaudet, tells a similar version on Michels' show, though he does not mention Dennett. He names the Catalina Channel, the water between the island and the mainland, as one of several hotspots in his broader argument that the oceans are full of UFOs. Both bring it up because, if true, unknown craft might be operating from under the sea just off a major American coastline.
